constraints.structure: two long ads; line i of the first ad and line i of the second ad are order-preserving halves of one plaintext phrase, with 3-12 letters freely omitted per line ('W.' omission rule); Bourdeau's permutation test on the paired line lengths found 'no random re-pairing in 100,000 comes that close', so the pairing mechanism itself is statistically established
constraints.agreed_partial_reading: an Oxford-classics frame is forced for five lines per Bourdeau's 15 Sept 2026 open-vocabulary exact-fit name search over 1,645 period proper nouns: CONINGTON, JOWETT, SHIRLEY, HERTFORD each the only name that fits its frame with no more omissions than the published reading; earlier readers (Bosbach: 'DYING DECLARATION'; Estes/'Dave': SUMMER TERM, 1853, BALLIOL) contributed the rest of the accumulated partial plaintext
constraints.unread_lines: lines 9, 12, 23, 26, 29 remain unread per Bourdeau's 'Remaining gaps' table (as of the 25 Sept 2026 fresh-clone check); a Latin-vocabulary exact-interleaving search on line 29 (Krajcovic's QUI FIT/Horace Satires hypothesis, control: line 17 correctly returns Horace's QUI FIT) found no two-word reading in Latin either
constraints.why_not_forced: the omission rule (3-12 letters freely inserted per line) lets 'plausible English... fit almost anything' (Bourdeau's own words, cited in NOTES.md); only a handful of lines are actually forced by the letters alone
